title: Hancock Whitney Celebrates Grand Reopening of Renovated Elmwood Financial Center
summary: Hancock Whitney Celebrates Grand Reopening of Renovated Elmwood Financial Center
body_markdown:
### Updated Harahan location reflects Hancock Whitney’s continued commitment to serving clients and communities across the New Orleans region


###


For More Information


Arian Pierre, PR & Social Media Producer
arian.pierre@hancockwhitney.com or 504.380.6257


*Representatives of Hancock Whitney celebrated the grand reopening of its newly renovated financial center in Harahan.*


**HARAHAN, La.** —


[Hancock Whitney](https://www.hancockwhitney.com/) celebrated the grand reopening of its newly renovated Elmwood financial center this week, underscoring Hancock Whitney’s longstanding commitment to serving individuals, families and businesses in Harahan and across the greater New Orleans region.


Located at **5200 Mounes St.** , the refreshed financial center offers an enhanced environment designed to better serve Hancock Whitney clients and provide convenient access to the bank’s comprehensive financial services.


Hancock Whitney leaders, associates, clients and community members gathered Wednesday, September 23, for a ribbon-cutting ceremony commemorating the reopening. The celebration also featured special appearances by the New Orleans Saints’ mascot and the Saints’ Super Bowl trophy, along with refreshments and giveaways for guests.


“We’re proud to welcome our clients and neighbors back to the newly renovated Elmwood financial center,” said Elizabeth Hefler, Greater New Orleans Regional President. “This investment reflects our commitment to being a strong, accessible financial partner for the people and businesses we serve throughout Jefferson Parish and the greater New Orleans region. We look forward to continuing to build relationships and help our clients achieve their financial goals from this refreshed location.”


The renovation reflects Hancock Whitney’s longstanding focus on providing clients with both personalized, local service and access to a broad range of financial solutions, including personal and business banking, lending, wealth management and other financial services.


About Hancock Whitney


Since the late 1800s, Hancock Whitney has embodied core values of Honor & Integrity, Strength & Stability, Commitment to Service, Teamwork, and Personal Responsibility. Hancock Whitney offices and financial centers in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, and Florida offer comprehensive financial products and services, including traditional and online banking; commercial and small business banking; private banking; trust and investment services; healthcare banking; and mortgage services. The company also operates combined loan and deposit production offices in the greater metropolitan areas of Nashville, Tennessee, and Atlanta, Georgia. More information is available at[www.hancockwhitney.com](https://www.hancockwhitney.com/) .
